newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Globe signs supply pact with Japanese firms.
newsitem.headline: Globe signs supply pact with Japanese firms.

text.p: Globe Telecom GMCR Inc signed agreements with Fujitsu Limited and Tomen Corp of Japan for digital switching and transmission equipment for 200,000 telephone lines, a Fujitsu statement said.
The statement issued on Wednesday said Globe was buying the equipment to meet its commitment to install 700,000 telephone lines.
Globe is a joint venture between Ayala Corp and Singapore Telecom International.
Globe is required to install 400,000 telephones lines as a mobile phone operator and another 300,000 lines as an international gateway facility (IGF) operator.
These line commitments were taken from Globe by the government in return for licences to operate cellular phones and the international gateway facility.
